<div class="docSubContent">

   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">
      
         
            <div id="docSubImgHTML" class="docSubContent current " data-show-on-open=".jsHideForDocSubVideo">
               
                  <div class="textSizeIncrement">
                     <div class="">
                        
                        

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="40025034-40025040" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/matthew/25/#v40025034-v40025040" target="_blank">Matthew 25:34-40</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Other sheep Jesus has, and they serve alongside</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">those anointed to be Christ’s heavenly bride.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">All the things that are done</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">for their comfort and aid</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">Are things he considers that must be repaid.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">“If you comforted them, you comforted me.</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">If you did it for them, you did it for me.</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sp">Your labors for them were your labors for me.</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sz">You did it for them; you did it for me.</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sp">If you did it for them, you did it for me.”</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>“Yes, you comforted me in my hunger and thirst,</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">and whatever my need, you came to me first.”</p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sp">“Tell us, when did we do this?”</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sz">these ones will reply.</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sp">The King will then answer them, telling them why:</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sp">“If you comforted them, you comforted me.</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sz">If you did it for them, you did it for me.</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sp">Your labors for them were your labors for me.</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sz">You did it for them; you did it for me.</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sp">If you did it for them, you did it for me.”</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>“You’ve been loyal to me, doing works that are fine,</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">as you preach alongside these brothers of mine.”</p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sp">So the King will then say</p>
<p id="p29" data-pid="29" class="p29 sz">to the sheep on his right:</p>
<p id="p30" data-pid="30" class="p30 sp">“Inherit the earth and perfection of life.”</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p31" data-pid="31" class="p31 se">(CHORUS)</p>
<p id="p32" data-pid="32" class="p32 sp">“If you comforted them, you comforted me.</p>
<p id="p33" data-pid="33" class="p33 sz">If you did it for them, you did it for me.</p>
<p id="p34" data-pid="34" class="p34 sp">Your labors for them were your labors for me.</p>
<p id="p35" data-pid="35" class="p35 sz">You did it for them; you did it for me.</p>
<p id="p36" data-pid="36" class="p36 sp">If you did it for them, you did it for me.”</p>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p37" data-pid="37" class="p37 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="20019017" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/proverbs/19/#v20019017" target="_blank">Prov. 19:17;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="40010040-40010042" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/matthew/10/#v40010040-v40010042" target="_blank"> Matt. 10:40-42;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="55001016-55001017" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/2-timothy/1/#v55001016-v55001017" target="_blank"> 2 Tim. 1:16, 17</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p38" class="displayNone"> </p>
